# firebase_database

**Tag**: firebase, database, realtime, mobile, tooling

## 简介

Flutter plugin for Firebase Database, a cloud-hosted NoSQL database with realtime data syncing across Android and iOS clients, and offline access.

## 官网

- 主页: https://firebase.google.com/docs/database
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/firebase/flutterfire/tree/main/packages/firebase_database/firebase_database
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/firebase_database
